user.title: Select SwitchBot Lock
user.description: Select a lock from the official SwitchBot Bluetooth integration. The wizard will download its current history and guide you through naming user IDs.

users.title: Name your users
users.description:
The following IDs were found in the logs. Enter a name for each ID below.

Automatic name assignment is unavailable: The SwitchBot app manages the names; the lock history only supplies user IDs. Compare each ID’s timestamp with the event log in the iOS / Android app. For example, find the action at the time shown below for ID 10. The app shows who unlocked the lock at that time. Enter that name in the field under ID 10, then repeat for the other IDs.

SwitchBot app Home → Select your lock → Event log

{count} unique events available. Times use your Home Assistant time zone. Previously saved IDs are also included. Existing names are prefilled; an empty field removes the mapping.

fetch_failed.title: Could not download history
fetch_failed.description: Check that the lock is reachable. Retry, or edit saved mappings and the last available history.

no_users.title: No user IDs found
no_users.description: The fetched history has no recognized user IDs or saved names. Unlock once with your fingerprint or keypad, then retry. App events can have no user ID.

review.title: Review history and finish
review.description:
Your user mappings have been saved. This is the history we could create:

**{status}**

{count} fingerprint accesses available. The latest 15 are shown below.

{events}

The integration is ready. The Last access sensor shows the latest name, with the timestamp and latest 100 accesses in its attributes. New live accesses appear in Activity. Open Configure later to download history and name IDs again. Use the standard Entities, Markdown or Activity dashboard cards; templates are in docs/DASHBOARD.md.

progress.fetch_history:
Downloading history from {device_name}. This can take up to 3 minutes.

Up to 100 read requests are made individually over Bluetooth. Duplicate entries are merged. Please keep this window open.

create_entry.default: Setup is complete. The integration is ready to use. Your user mappings have been saved. Open Configure to download history again and edit names.

device_not_configured.message: This device is not configured for lock logs. Add it via the integration setup first.

fetch_logs_error.message: Failed to fetch lock logs from the device.

get_lock_logs.name: Get lock logs
get_lock_logs.description: Fetches lock records and returns only fingerprint openings. Locking and unknown events are hidden; the complete raw archive is preserved. The maximum entry count limits the Bluetooth request, so fewer openings may be displayed.

max_entries.name: Maximum entries
max_entries.description: Maximum number of log entries to retrieve.

base_time.name: Start time
base_time.description: Unix timestamp for the history cursor (uint32, 0 = all).

set_lock_user_name.name: Set lock user name
set_lock_user_name.description: Map a user ID to a friendly name for lock logs.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: User ID from lock logs (found in payload, typically 0-255).

name.name: Name
name.description: Friendly name for this user (e.g., "Dad's Fingerprint", "Guest Code").

get_stored_lock_logs.name: Get stored lock history
get_stored_lock_logs.description: Return all persistently archived events without a Bluetooth download. New downloads do not delete older events.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device ID of the official lock.
